title: Redesigning VolunteerMatch’s Search Algorithm: Toward More Equitable Access to Volunteers
eligible_reason: Single-date field experiment. The redesigned search algorithm launched in Dallas (treatment) in week 21 of 2022, with Houston as the control market. Opportunity-week regressions of log sign-ups on treated (Dallas x post) use city and post or week FE (Table 2). One treated market and one date. The package generates synthetic data because the VolunteerMatch data are proprietary.
design_notes: ReplicationPackage-SyntheticExperiment.ipynb: smf.ols specifications 'city + treated + post', 'week_factor + city + treated', and versions adding logsum; HC3 SEs.
data_files_note: README: synthetic experimental data generated in-notebook; results are not intended to match.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text).
